title: WooCommerce Store Launch
description: Pre-launch checklist for new WooCommerce stores — payments, shipping, taxes, and test orders.

steps.title: Set Store Address & Currency
steps.instructions: Configure store address, selling location, default customer location, and currency under WooCommerce → General.

steps.title: Configure Payment Gateways
steps.instructions: Enable Stripe, PayPal, or other gateways in live mode. Complete KYC and verify webhook endpoints respond with 200.

steps.title: Set Up Shipping Zones
steps.instructions: Create zones for each region you ship to. Add flat-rate, free shipping, or live-rate methods and test edge postcodes.

steps.title: Configure Tax Rules
steps.instructions: Enable taxes if required. Set prices inclusive/exclusive of tax and verify rates for each jurisdiction you sell into.

steps.title: Customize Order Emails
steps.instructions: Brand WooCommerce email templates with logo and colors. Send test new-order, processing, and completed emails.

steps.title: Place Test Orders
steps.instructions: Complete test purchases with each payment method. Verify order emails, stock reduction, and admin new-order notifications.

steps.title: Link Shop Policies
steps.instructions: Assign refund, privacy, and terms pages in WooCommerce settings. Ensure checkout shows required policy checkboxes.

steps.title: Verify Empty Cart & 404s
steps.instructions: Browse shop categories, product variations, and out-of-stock items. Fix broken variation URLs and empty cart behavior.
